title: Purchase invoices
description: Supplier invoices: drafts, approvals and what they added to stock.
emptyHint: Record a supplier's invoice to add the goods to stock.

form.help: Enter unit costs before VAT. VAT is added per line from its tax class.
form.search: Add a product (name, SKU or barcode)
form.serialsLater: Serials can be added later, before approval.
form.chooseBoth: Choose the supplier and the branch.

detail.title: Purchase invoice {number}

approvals.emptyHint: Invoices above the approval limit appear here when a manager approves them.
